prompt: Your phone is worth $\$500$ new and loses $20\%$ of its value each year. How many dollars is it worth after 2 years?
hint: Losing 20% means keeping 80%: multiply by 0.80 each year.

hints.text: Losing 20% means keeping 80%: multiply by 0.80 each year.

explanation: Each year the phone keeps 80% of its value: factor 0.80.

alternativeExplanations.title: Year-by-year table
steps: Notice it loses $100 the first year but only $80 the second — decay shrinks by a factor, not a fixed amount.

alternativeExplanations.title: Slice off a fifth twice
steps: Losing 20% = losing one fifth. One fifth of 500 is 100, leaving 400.
One fifth of 400 is 80, leaving 320. Value: $320.
